verdict.rationale: Cortex Analyst is a built-in, documented Snowflake feature that lets users ask questions in natural language and get answers 'without writing SQL,' implying it generates and runs SQL against the user's schema inside Snowsight; Cortex AI Functions and Notebooks further support SQL/Python assistance in-product. However, the evidence never explicitly shows the assistant 'fixing' or 'explaining' existing SQL (vs. generating it from scratch), and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of accuracy or workflow beyond first-party docs. Missing for 10: explicit fix/explain-SQL capability documentation, and independent/community validation of the NL-to-SQL experience.
